label: Customer reports
description: Customer activity for a single reporting period.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period.

fields.label: Period start
fields.description: When the period starts (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Period end
fields.description: When the period ends (shown in your local time). Orders from this moment on fall in the next period.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency the amounts are reported in.

fields.label: Customers
fields.description: Different customers who placed at least one paid order in this period.

fields.label: Previous period customers
fields.description: The same count for the period of equal length just before this one.

fields.label: Change vs previous period
fields.description: Percentage change in customers compared with the previous period.

fields.label: New customers
fields.description: Customers whose first ever paid order was in this period.

fields.label: Returning customers
fields.description: Customers who had already placed a paid order before this period.

fields.label: Repeat buyers
fields.description: Customers who placed two or more paid orders in this period.

fields.label: Repeat rate %
fields.description: Share of this period's customers who are repeat buyers.

fields.label: Returning rate %
fields.description: Share of this period's customers who are returning customers.

fields.label: Average spend per customer
fields.description: Total spent by this period's customers, divided by the number of customers.

fields.label: Customer report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this period. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.

rows.label: Customers
rows.hint: Different customers who placed at least one paid order in this period.

rows.label: Previous period

rows.label: Change vs previous period
rows.hint: Percentage change in customers compared with the previous period.

fields.label: Top customers
